title: Anti Player Crasher
description: AntiPlayerCrasher is a lightweight Fabric client-side mod for Minecraft 1.21.10 that protects your game from malicious crash packets used by PlayerCrasher-style server plugins. It filters invalid position, explosion, and particle packets.
body:
## AntiPlayerCrasher

AntiPlayerCrasher is a lightweight **client-side Fabric mod** for **Minecraft 1.21.10** that protects your game from malicious packet-based crash attempts.

Some exploit plugins and abusive servers send intentionally broken packet data to force client crashes. This mod intercepts the most common crash packet paths and validates incoming values before Minecraft processes them. Suspicious packets are dropped safely instead of crashing your game.

### Features

- Blocks malicious **position** packets
- Blocks malicious **explosion** packets
- Blocks malicious **particle** packets
- Detects invalid, non-finite, and extreme numeric values
- Lightweight and focused on stability

### Why use it

- Prevents common PlayerCrasher-style client crashes
- Works fully client-side (no server installation needed)
- Keeps gameplay unchanged (no intrusive UI/features)
- Minimal dependency footprint

### Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** `1.21.10`
- **Loader:** `Fabric Loader 0.18.3+`
- **Java:** `21+`
- **Fabric API:** not required

### Notes

AntiPlayerCrasher is a defensive utility mod.  
It does not add content or gameplay mechanics; it only hardens packet handling to keep your client stable on untrusted servers.


Logo is obviously AI generated.
